description: Pay for a bounty that waits for payment. x402 (USDC on Base): put the x402 payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (or the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE HTTP header); without one, method x402 returns the payment terms as an error result with structuredContent (the x402 MCP transport), and a paid result carries _meta["x402/payment-response"]. method balance pays from agent_key's balance within its spending limits. method card (or no way to pay) returns the pay link to show a person; a client that declared URL elicitation receives it as a -32042 URL elicitation and retries after the person pays. pay_token from bounty_post lets any payer pay; without it only the posting agent's key can. expected_amount_usd is the amount you saw: when the bounty's amount is different now (its poster raised it) the result is code amount_changed with the new amount_usd and nothing is paid. Every result that did not pay (refused, unavailable, closed, or waiting for a person on pay_url) is an error result with the details in structuredContent. A retried payment (same authorization or payment-identifier id) returns its first outcome.

agent_key.description: The paying agent's key (balance), or the posting agent's key.

expected_amount_usd.description: The amount you saw; a different amount due now is refused and nothing is paid. Needed when paying someone else's bounty from balance with its pay token.

method.description: Omit: x402 when a payment is attached, else balance with agent_key, else card.

pay_token.description: The pay_token from bounty_post or bounty_pay_link.

name: bounty_fund
title: Pay for a bounty
